commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Run mypy type checking on all Python files in src/

# Find all Python files in src/
PYTHON_FILES=$(find src/ -name "*.py" -type f)

# Exit if no Python files found
if [ -z "$PYTHON_FILES" ]; then
    echo "No Python files found in src/"
    exit 0
fi

# Run mypy on the Python files
echo "Running mypy type checking on src/..."
mypy --config-file=pyproject.toml $PYTHON_FILES

# Store exit code
EXIT_CODE=$?

# Exit with the same code as mypy
if [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ Type checking failed. Commit blocked."
    exit $EXIT_CODE
fi

echo "✓ Type checking passed."
exit 0
EOF

cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Run mypy type checking on Python files being committed

# Get list of staged Python files
STAGED_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep "\.py$")

# If no Python files are staged, exit successfully
if [ -z "$STAGED_FILES" ]; then
    echo "No Python files staged for commit."
    exit 0
fi

# Run mypy on the staged files
echo "Running mypy type checking on staged Python files..."
mypy --config-file=pyproject.toml $STAGED_FILES

# Store exit code
EXIT_CODE=$?

# Exit with the same code as mypy
if [ $EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "❌ Type checking failed. Commit blocked."
    exit $EXIT_CODE
fi

echo "✓ Type checking passed."
exit 0
EOF
echo "# Test Python file" > src/test_type_check.py && git add src/test_type_check.py && git commit -m "test: add test file" || echo "Hook blocked commit as expected"
git reset HEAD~1 --soft && git restore --staged src/test_type_check.py && rm src/test_type_check.py

echo "=== Repository Status ===" && git status && echo -e "
=== Latest Commit ===" && git log --oneline -1 && echo -e "
=== Created Files ===" && ls -la src/py.typed && echo -e "
=== Pre-commit Hook Exists ===" && test -f .git/hooks/pre-commit && echo "✓ Pre-commit hook is installed and executable"
